state.customer_message: The screen protector is cracked. I dropped my phone on the pavement yesterday and the protector cracked across the middle. I want my money back.
state.photo_description: Phone with a cracked protector, fine cracks radiating from one corner.

terminology.definition: An item marked final sale cannot be returned or refunded, except when it is defective on arrival.
Broken or not working when delivered. Damage caused by the customer after delivery is not defective.

criteria.agree: The customer's own account says the damage happened after the item was delivered.
criteria.disagree: The customer's own account does not say the damage happened after delivery.
